title: Israeli Drone Strike Kills Jaber Kamal Meqbel in Deir al-Balah; Vehicle Carrying His Body Struck Again Near Gaza City
detail: At around 12:30 on September 24, 2026, an Israeli drone fired a missile at a vehicle in the northwestern part of Deir al-Balah, central Gaza, killing 35-year-old Jaber Kamal Jaber Meqbel and wounding eight others. Roughly three hours later, at around 15:20, a second Israeli drone fired a missile at a civilian vehicle transporting Meqbel's body near the al-Baydar area, southwest of Gaza City, wounding nine more Palestinians. The injured were taken to al-'Awda Hospital in Nuseirat, al-Shifa Medical Complex and al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital in Deir al-Balah.

title: Drone Strike on Khan Younis Supermarket Wounds Group, Kills Hasan Takrim al-Battah
detail: At around 13:20 on September 24, 2026, an Israeli drone fired a missile at a group of Palestinians near the al-'Abdasawi Supermarket in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, wounding five, including 42-year-old Hasan Takrim Hafez al-Battah. Al-Battah later succumbed to his wounds, becoming the fifth fatality in the Gaza Health Ministry's toll for the 24-hour reporting period that also included Jaber Kamal Meqbel and Muhannad Abu Medyin.

media.caption: Aftermath of continued Israeli strikes across Gaza, late Sep 2026

title: Israeli Forces Shoot and Kill Muhannad Abu Medyin West of Al-Zahra, Central Gaza
detail: Israeli forces shot 33-year-old Muhannad Hassan Abu Medyin (also transliterated Abu Madin) west of the town of al-Zahra in central Gaza on September 24, 2026. He was brought to al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, where medical sources confirmed his death. His killing was counted among the five Palestinians the Gaza Health Ministry reported killed in the 24-hour period spanning September 24-25.

media.caption: Israeli fire kills Muhannad Abu Medyin near al-Zahra, central Gaza, Sep 24, 2026
